comparison.objective: Clamp a wooden strip and saw off a 150 mm retained piece.
comparison.physical_skill: Vise tightening, cut-line selection, and repeated sawing-force control.
comparison.success_condition: Exactly two physical pieces; retained length 150 ±1 mm; vise tight and saw clear; cutting before clamping fails.
comparison.reason: Both create separated material, but sawing tests extended abrasive cutting to a length tolerance; the candidate tests discrete impact fracture at manufactured notches and recovery of four millimetre-scale tangs.
